lead_headline: Restaurant tracker hits 265 live leads as Giorgios, La Vietta, and Re Tre open while foreclosures stay quiet

restaurant.blurb: 6 new leads today: Giorgios Pizza (Virginia Vale), La Vietta Italian trattoria (Highland), Re Tre Vietnamese (Athmar Park), Shawarma Max (University Hills), plus Taco John's closure in Globeville.

liquor.blurb: Still zero new applications — the drought now extends three full weeks with no bar, restaurant, or retail license filings detected. The 12,325-license database hasn't logged a single new application since early June, marking an unusual summer lull. Previous comparable dry spells lasted 7-10 days at most. Worth monitoring whether this signals a broader pullback in hospitality expansion or simply seasonal timing around the July 4 holiday week.

reputation.blurb: 8 mentions yesterday including CBS News coverage of the Denver hotel bat bite lawsuit and Instagram discussion of downtown commercial distress. The 7-day total climbed to 65 mentions across 13 sources, up from 57 the prior week. Facebook dominates with 19 pickups, followed by Reddit (12) and Instagram/X (7 each). Hoodline contributed 5 local news aggregations. The week's mix tilts toward real estate and public safety stories rather than restaurant/business news.

subscriptions.blurb: Net flat yesterday (0 new, 0 canceled), holding MTD at +0 after the month opened at breakeven. 90-day net remains +129. The past week delivered −5 net (1 new, 6 canceled), reversing the prior week's +2. June closed weak with five consecutive flat days after mid-month volatility — a June 18 spike of +5 was erased four trading days later by a −5 cancellation wave. The YTD pace of +1.1/day stays intact, but recent two-week momentum has stalled compared to the steady spring accumulation pattern.
